findings.message:
[P3] Doc comments stranded by the module split

The move left two method comments attached to the wrong functions: `collectCheckRuns` now carries the `readBaseReviewChecks` comment (client-checks.ts line 234) while `readBaseReviewChecks` lost its own comment, and the old `collectCheckRuns` comment now sits above `readProtections` (client-reads.ts line 176). Only documentation accuracy is affected; no runtime behavior changes.

src/github/client-checks.ts:234-235

summary: Behavior-preserving split: check reads and workflow-event enrichment move verbatim from client-reads.ts to the new client-checks.ts, and the two public constants are re-exported. No functional defect found; the only issue is two doc comments left attached to the wrong methods by the move.

evidence: src/github/client-reads.ts is 342 lines at the candidate, below the 500-line target (the base was 699 lines).

The new src/github/client-checks.ts (377 lines) holds the workflow-event enrichment: MAX_WORKFLOW_EVENT_READS, WORKFLOW_EVENT_PATTERN, workflowRunId, readWorkflowEvent and enrichCheckEvents at lines 45-208.

GitHubClientChecks extends GitHubClientIssues and GitHubClientReads extends GitHubClientChecks, so readChecks/readCheckSuites and the re-exported PENDING_STATUS_GRACE_MS/MAX_WORKFLOW_EVENT_READS remain available to existing consumers.
